claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Heat Metal targets a manufactured metal object (weapon or suit of armor), not a creature or area. The Attachment union has no 'object' variant. Without it the attachment target cannot be represented honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose a manufactured metal object, such as a metal weapon or a suit of Heavy or Medium metal armor, that you can see within range.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation.bonus_action_damage_pulse
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell deals damage at cast time AND allows the caster to spend a Bonus Action on each later turn to re-deal the same damage while the object is in range. Neither 'roll_modifier' nor 'damage_on_hit' models this: roll_modifier is a passive addend to existing rolls; damage_on_hit fires on attack-roll hits. A new operation kind is needed for 'caster pays Bonus Action → deal fixed damage to spell target' that also fires automatically on the initial cast.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Bonus Action on each of your later turns to deal this damage again if the object is within range

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingEffectMechanics.operations (array, currently single field)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: OngoingEffectMechanics has a single 'operation' field. Heat Metal requires two distinct operations: (1) the bonus-action damage pulse; (2) a damage-triggered CON save gate that fires each time the creature takes damage from the object. A single-operation model cannot express both honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or drop the object if it can. If it doesn't drop the object, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of your next turn.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: RollKind.ability_check
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The disadvantage rider applies to 'attack rolls and ability checks'. RollKind is currently 'attack_roll' | 'saving_throw'. Ability checks are a third distinct roll kind required to express this penalty.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of your next turn

claude_proposed_widenings.name: force_drop_object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: On a failed CON save the creature must drop the held/worn object if it can. No existing v4 effect atom covers 'forced release of a held item'. The closest, force_move, is creature locomotion. This is a distinct mechanical effect: transferring an item from a creature's possession to the ground.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or drop the object if it can
